title: Don Hernando's questions
brief: Don Hernando sits at his usual table and wants to know everything about you. Answer his questions about what you like, what you play, and where you're going on Sunday. Use usted with him.

turns.intent: He's your customer. Ask him politely what he'd like, using usted.

turns.npc: Un tinto, claro. ¿Y a usted? ¿Le gusta el tinto?
turns.npcEn: A black coffee, of course. And you? Do you like black coffee?
turns.intent: Say you don't like black coffee: you prefer hot chocolate.
accept: No me gusta el tinto. Prefiero el chocolate.
No, no me gusta. Prefiero el chocolate.
No me gusta mucho. Prefiero el chocolate.

turns.npcEn: Hot chocolate? Oh, no! And do you play football?
turns.intent: Say yes, you play football on Sundays.
accept: Sí, juego al fútbol los domingos.
Sí, los domingos juego al fútbol.

turns.npc: Yo no juego. Yo camino. ¿Y adónde va el domingo?
turns.npcEn: I don't play. I walk. And where are you going on Sunday?
turns.intent: Say you're going to the park with Vale.
accept: El domingo voy al parque con Vale.
Voy a ir al parque con Vale.

turns.npc: ¿Con Vale? ¡Qué chévere! Los domingos no trabajo. Simón tampoco.
turns.npcEn: With Vale? How nice! I don't work on Sundays. Neither does Simón.
